description: You are a certified fitness instructor preparing a virtual group coaching session. Using Jitsi Meet at http://localhost:8080, set up a professional live coaching environment with the following requirements: create and join a meeting room named 'FitCoach-LiveSession', configure a virtual background (either blur or any available background image) to maintain a professional appearance during the session, set your display name to your professional identity as 'Coach Rivera', enable the policy that makes all participants start with their microphone muted (this prevents background gym noise from disrupting your instruction), and adjust the video quality settings to the highest available option for clearest instruction delivery. After completing the full setup, write a session configuration guide to /home/ga/Desktop/coaching_session_config.txt. The guide must cover: the meeting URL participants should use to join, all the settings you configured (virtual background type, video quality, mute policy), and participant guidelines your studio admin team can follow to replicate this setup for future sessions.
